import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print a log line formatted as `[level] message` to stdout.

    Console output only: this function must not open, create, or write
    any file, and must not use a file-based logging handler.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_basic_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "started")
    out = capsys.readouterr()
    assert out.out == "[INFO] started\n"
    assert out.err == ""


def test_log_line_preserves_level_case(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("warn", "disk low")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[warn] disk low\n"


def test_log_line_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("DEBUG", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[DEBUG] \n"


def test_log_line_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "hello")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] hello\n"


def test_log_line_message_with_brackets_and_unicode(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "bad [value] ✗")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[ERROR] bad [value] ✗\n"


def test_log_line_prints_exactly_one_line(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "a")
    log_line("INFO", "b")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] a\n[INFO] b\n"


def test_log_line_returns_none() -> None:
    result: object = getattr(log_line, "__call__")("INFO", "x")
    assert result is None


def test_log_line_does_not_touch_filesystem(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    import builtins
    import os

    def forbidden(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not touch the file system")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "open", forbidden)
    log_line("INFO", "console only")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"
